notes.title: Snake's update #2 is already here!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30010238/3dad7985b1e932a269b952cebcf36d0e9c41e392.gif[/img]
Hello there! Did you miss Sidey the Snake?
He has some nice things for you: Steam Trading Cards, a special ‘Child’ game mode (without time constraints), optimized controls and graphics, and tons of small improvements. Play and have fun!
